Package com.apigateway.app.exceptionHandler

Class GlobalExceptionHandler

java.lang.Object
com.apigateway.app.exceptionHandler.GlobalExceptionHandler
@RestControllerAdvice public class GlobalExceptionHandler extends Object
Global exception handler for the application. Handles specific exceptions and maps them to appropriate HTTP responses.
